field_overrides name a DIFFERENT yardstick for named fields, for when the base family's weapon does not hold the same position in both games. The Assault Rifle is the fastest automatic weapon in Halo 4 (1500) and one of the slowest in Halo 3 (80), so bullet speed measured against it swings wildly; the Machine Gun sits beside the SAW in both. A game with no weapon for the override family falls back to the base family.
